rule: Every scored coefficient must have theorem_zero_certificate or numeric_value + units + source_path + source_exists.
Massless C_R/r tail may enter PPN/orbital only; finite R10 requires Z_R/M_R^2/lambda_range.
Z_R, M_R^2, beta charges, C_R/Pi_R, kappa_W and M_* must be in a declared common parent/source frame.
No arena can pass by cancellation between unrelated residual vector components unless a parent identity proves that cancellation.
